summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Grand Terrace transactions and use (sales) tax.

tax.text: Measure N would enact a 1% local sales tax to fund city services and community priorities.
tax.quote: If approved, Measure N would establish a 1% local transactions and use tax (sales tax).

tax.text: A No vote opposes Measure N, which would establish a 1% local sales tax to fund city services and community priorities.
